name: Hyoui Tengoku
source:
Hero calls a girl who he loves for a long time to the school roof to confess his feelings, but gets dumped. He gets to the heavens as a result of an accident but is kicked from there for harassing the angels. Appearing right near his passion getting into a love hotel with her boyfriend our ghost manages to possess him and that opens the doors to various fully animated sexual encounters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
